shape: two cycles of groove -> climb (G1, D#2) -> void -> drop, then the gated drop 2, then the build's walk returns as the outro

start_note: The first section's t0 is the START OF THE FILE, not a transition, and it is not gradeable as a boundary event. `buildMap` forces sections[0].t0 to 0 (bar 0 is 0.0172, and a section list must cover the track), and no frame's half-open (tPrev, t] can contain 0 unless tPrev < 0 — so the engine fires it on its very FIRST frame, which is frame 1, one frame before `tools/filetrace.js` can start recording (the deterministic recipe holds the clock at frame 1 while the track decodes and the window begins at frame 2, docs/HARNESS.md 'File source'). Measured: the event IS in ENGINE.LOG and the page's own boundary list has all 13, but the trace's first frame is heard 0.0167 s and the crossing already happened. `compare.py --make-synth` fires one on frame 0 only because it builds the trace itself from t = 0.
walk_note: `attack` = the E0 bar line the note starts on (the walk is one note every second bar, bars 8 / 10 / 12 / 14). `lowOnset` = the truth's own 40-150 Hz HPSS onset, 4-21 ms of the bar line in every case. `arrival` = the first frame of contour.f0td that NAMES the note, 40-140 ms later, because a 100 ms YIN window has to fill before it can. v1's four numbers were 10 Hz run-length labels: 13.0 is 0.19 s after the attack, 22.6 is 0.19 s after it, and a pickup figure at 15.232 / 15.372 / 15.673 is what made 16.1 look like the arrival. Grade an event against `attack`, a pitch channel against `arrival`. Read contour.f0td at `fpsExact` (100.2273 Hz), NOT at the nominal `fps` 100: at 100 Hz the labels drift 358 ms by the end of the track.

not_drops.why: the engine fired a full-strength dropEvt here in v0.14 (AUDIT-v0.14 §3). v1 put it at '~9-10 s'; there is NO sub anywhere before 12.799 s, so what v0.14 fired on is the sub LAYER ENTRY at bar 8 (12.8146), not something at 9-10 s. A layer entry, not a drop: the bar has the same energy as drop 1 (0.85 against 0.86 of the track p90, because the track is limited and the sub is 68-79 % of the energy there) and no kick at all, which is why the drop rule needs the kick-density gate and not an energy threshold (docs/workers/ears.md 4.1).
